comment: How tokens are counted per model family (design section 7, Context assembly). 'match' patterns are matched in order against the model id without any provider or namespace prefix, case-insensitively, '*' being a wildcard; the last family must match '*'. 'tokenizer' is 'o200k_base' or 'cl100k_base' (Microsoft.ML.Tokenizers, exact) or 'estimate'. An estimate counts every decimal digit as 'digitTokens' tokens (Qwen and Gemma split numbers into single digits) and every other character as 1 / 'charsPerToken' tokens, then adds 'safetyMargin' (10%). charsPerToken is the non-digit characters of the fixture corpus (tests/Pillion.ModelGateway.Tests/Fixtures/Tokens/corpus: four C#, TypeScript and Python files, 17,506 characters of which 231 are digits) divided by the tokens they took, measured on 2026-10-09 with Ollama 0.40.1 (prompt_eval_count of a raw /api/generate request, the BOS token removed). Families that could not be measured on the development machine use the lowest measured ratio. The Llama 3 family is counted with cl100k_base: its tokenizer keeps cl100k_base's 100,000 ranks and pre-tokenizer pattern and adds 28,000 ranks, so cl100k_base counts are an upper bound in practice.
